description: We are Mittus, a Brazilian team passionate about technology, innovation, and space exploration. Our goal is to develop an AI-powered health monitoring solution to support astronaut safety during space missions. We combine skills in Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, and Software Engineering to turn complex challenges into practical solutions. We welcome creative minds interested in AI, data, development, and design!
summary: Mittus is a web prototype that helps astronauts track their wellbeing during long missions. Crew members record sleep, fatigue, mood, stress, and team conflict in a daily check-in. They can review changes over time and see suggested follow-up tasks. The demonstration uses simulated records to show how astronauts could notice changes in their own health and decide what to monitor next.
details:
Mittus is a web prototype that helps astronauts track changes in their wellbeing during long missions. Crew members complete a daily check-in to record sleep, perceived fatigue, mood, stress, and team conflict. The history view lets them compare recent sleep and fatigue records over time.

With enough check-ins, Eres estimates the likelihood of reporting high fatigue at the next check-in. Ceres turns the check-in and forecast into a plain-language explanation and suggests follow-up tasks for the daily checklist. The demo uses simulated check-ins, and Eres is an experimental model trained on synthetic data.

NASA’s research on inadequate sleep and irregular schedules informed our decision to track sleep duration and self-reported fatigue together. OpenAI Codex assisted with development.

Source code: Mittus web app, backend, and Eres · Ceres recommendation service
